crossRefs.note: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a…
to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;
punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

translations.web: I will execute vengeance in anger, and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”
translations.bsb: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.”
translations.kjv: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
translations.asv: And I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations which hearkened not.
